| 4 | K8s State | Kubernetes | `container.waiting_reason: "CrashLoopBackOff"`, `last_exit_code: 137`, `restart_count: 3` (fact-0efb46c5a242, fact-ec4f7c51ce71, fact-20b27ca73111) | 描述系统因重复 OOM 崩溃而进入的自我保护性重启循环状态 |
